text:
Nina P.: Quick heads up — Ramesh's contractor SOW ends 2026-03-31. Need to close invoices, confirm equipment return (he's remote EU), revoke access to model infra, and check if any equity/option paperwork applies.
Ramesh (Contractor): Correct, last billed day 3/31. I have a company laptop + hotspot. No RSUs but I do have a small contractor token grant (grant-id CG-2024-57). How does that get handled?
Omar (Finance): Contractor grants are processed via the contractor equity group. Usually a final vest review and a termination certificate. Pinged contractor-equity@redwood. Will need signed SOW termination and final invoice.
Sasha (Eng Manager): Also want Ramesh to hand over the optimization notebook and the scheduled retrain cron (runs weekly). Please list any crons or service accounts you own.
Ramesh (Contractor): I own service account svc-ramesh-trainer and a few API keys for the internal eval infra (eval-api-key-3). Cron is at project/retrain: weekly on Mon 02:00 UTC.
Leo (IT): We'll need to rotate those service keys and reassign the service account. Plan: rotate keys 03/31 18:00 UTC and disable account 04/01 02:00 UTC. For remote device return, we can provide a pre-paid shipping label to EU addresses. Ramesh, confirm shipping address?
Ramesh (Contractor): Shipping: Kopenhagengade 8, 2. tv, 2100 Copenhagen, Denmark. I'll drop at DHL tomorrow if you send label.
Lina (Facilities): We can issue a DHL label. Use return portal: https://facilities.redwood.com/shipping-returns and select "international pickup". I'll coordinate pickup window.
Kofi (Payroll): Note on final payment: contractors are paid upon invoice clearance. Please file final invoice by 4/5 COB for the March run. Also submit any outstanding expenses to Expensify with code CONTRACT-CLOSE.
Mei (Legal): For the contractor grant (CG-2024-57), I need the grant docs. If it's below threshold we typically void future vesting on termination date; any vested portion remains subject to the grant terms. I'll pull the contract and confirm. Also please preserve Slack convo for 12 months per compliance.
Nina P.: Exit interview — for contractors we do a 15-min wrap call to capture handover notes and feedback. Proposed 2026-03-29 09:00 CET. Ramesh ok?
Ramesh (Contractor): 3/29 09:00 CET works.
Sasha (Eng Manager): I'll attend and take notes on runbooks and ownership. Also request a short doc in the repo: docs/ops/ramesh-handover.md.
Ramesh (Contractor): I'll create that doc and push before 3/25. Will include runbook links and owner assignments.
Leo (IT): Example deprovision steps I'll run on schedule (adding to ticket #IT-5237):
```
# rotate eval API key
kv rotate eval-api-key-3 --owner=team-evals
# reassign service account
gcloud iam service-accounts set-iam-policy svc-ramesh-trainer --policy=team-evals-policy
# disable account
./disable_service_account.sh --sa=svc-ramesh-trainer --after=2026-04-01T02:00Z
```
Mei (Legal): One flag: the contractor used a personal laptop to run certain tests and uploaded datasets to a personal S3 bucket for intermediate storage. We need confirmation that no PII or customer data is in that bucket. Sasha, can you confirm with Ramesh during handover?
Sasha (Eng Manager): I'll ask during exit interview and mark it high priority. If anything remains, we'll request data deletion and a signed attestation.
Omar (Finance): Also check expense reimbursements for last-minute travel; finance will hold final payment until invoices + expenses are reconciled. Typical turnaround 1-2 payroll cycles after submission.
Kofi (Payroll): Adding: if contractor invoices include currency conversion, include the FX breakdown in the invoice to avoid delays.
Nina P.: Summary actions and owners: 1) Ramesh: upload handover doc by 2026-03-25; 2) Ramesh: final invoice submitted by 2026-04-05; 3) Leo: issue DHL label and rotate keys per ticket IT-5237 (scheduled 2026-03-31 18:00 UTC); 4) Mei: confirm contractor grant handling and send termination confirmation; 5) Sasha: verify no PII in personal buckets and capture runbook owners in exit interview 2026-03-29 09:00 CET; 6) Lina: coordinate pickup/label. 7) Kofi/Omar: reconcile final payments after invoices.
Ramesh (Contractor): thanks all. I'll get the doc + invoice in on time and confirm the bucket contents by 3/28.
Leo (IT): Ticket created IT-5237 and assigned. Will post updates and attach timestamps when keys are rotated.
Mei (Legal): I'll post a short note when the grant review is complete.
Nina P.: If no objections, we'll operate on this timeline. Please reply here if any dates need changing. :white_check_mark:
